what_to_detect: A combat in which an attacking creature that has an evasion keyword (flying) is blocked by a creature that could not legally block it, because the keyword was gained after the block was declared.
near_miss: A combat in which a blocked attacker with flying is blocked only by creatures with flying or reach.
record_fields: combat payload events: blockers_declared, became_blocked, removed_from_combat, damage_dealt
combat snapshot keywords on the attacker and blockers

what_to_detect: A blockers legality record listing a creature that must block if able, which is untapped and able to block the anchored attacker (a block requirement in force).
near_miss: A blockers legality record whose listed creatures have none that must block.
record_fields: blockers payload must_block per listed creature (gen-3)

what_to_detect: A blockers legality record listing a creature that must block if able alongside a restriction (menace, min_blockers) that limits how the requirement can be obeyed.
near_miss: A blockers legality record with a must-block creature and no competing restriction.
record_fields: blockers payload must_block per listed creature (gen-3)

what_to_detect: A combat in which a creature declared as a blocker is a blocking creature: it appears in the blocks mapping of the combat record and deals or receives combat damage as a blocker.
near_miss: A combat with an attacker and an untapped potential blocker where no block was declared, so no creature is blocking.
record_fields: combat payload events: blockers_declared, became_blocked, removed_from_combat, damage_dealt

what_to_detect: A combat record in which an attacker is a blocked creature (it has a block entry or a became_blocked event) although none of its blockers remain in combat (removed_from_combat), so it deals no combat damage unless it has trample.
near_miss: A combat record in which an attacker is unblocked and deals its damage to the player.
record_fields: combat payload events: blockers_declared, became_blocked, removed_from_combat, damage_dealt

what_to_detect: A decision (priority) record at the first priority stop of the declare blockers step whose snapshot stack holds a trigger that the blocker declaration caused.
near_miss: A priority record at a step with no such trigger pending, whose stack holds no trigger.

what_to_detect: A 'whenever this creature blocks a creature' trigger (in Forge Mode$ AttackerBlocked with ValidBlocker$ naming the trigger's own card) fires, once for each attacker its card blocks.
near_miss: The same kind of trigger is evaluated against a block and does not fire, the block not being one its card made.
record_fields: acting line's script root ValidBlocker$ (sidecar script text)

what_to_detect: A creature put onto the battlefield blocking an attacker (token_created or zone_change to the battlefield while blockers are declared) that is in the blocks mapping but has no blockers_declared or became_blocked event of its own, so it never 'blocked'.
near_miss: A creature declared as a blocker, which has a blockers_declared event.
record_fields: token_created / zone_change to battlefield during the declare blockers step

what_to_detect: A creature put onto the battlefield blocking an attacker that left combat before it entered, so it is on the battlefield but in no blocks entry.
near_miss: A creature put onto the battlefield blocking an attacker still in combat, which appears in the blocks mapping.
record_fields: token_created / zone_change to battlefield during the declare blockers step

what_to_detect: A creature put onto the battlefield blocking an attacker whose block would have broken a block restriction on that attacker, yet the creature is in the blocks mapping.
near_miss: A declared blocker listed as forbidden by a restriction, which is not in the blocks mapping.
record_fields: token_created / zone_change to battlefield during the declare blockers step
